charts.title: WASP-74 b: orbits around WASP-74
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-74's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-74 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Luque et al. 2020 (2020A&A...642A..50L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LUQUE_ET_AL__2020): P 2.13775138 d

charts.title: WASP-74 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-74 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (81) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 244089109, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
